midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, primary CTA fill, strong borders — the dominant brand dark; a slightly blue-tinted near-black that reads warmer than pure black on white

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page canvas, card surfaces, button text on dark fills

ash-border.$description: Ash Border — Default hairline borders, button outlines, icon strokes

carbon-nav.$description: Carbon Nav — Navigation text and thin nav borders — sits one step lighter than Midnight Ink

mist-blue.$description: Mist Blue — Cool-tinted card borders and subtle section dividers

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — SVG fills, icon glyphs, and high-contrast decorative shapes only — not used for UI text or backgrounds

prism-blue.$description: Prism Blue — Brand accent and logo mark — the cool anchor of the rainbow; also acts as info/state accent on badges and borders; Signature iridescent gradient — the through-line of the brand, sweeping pink → blue → yellow → green like light through a prism

prism-pink.$description: Prism Pink — Accent stroke and badge accent — warm half of the prism spectrum

prism-yellow.$description: Prism Yellow — Accent stroke and warning/state highlight

prism-green.$description: Prism Green — Accent stroke and success state highlight

cream-wash.$description: Cream Wash — Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the yellow accent

mint-wash.$description: Mint Wash — Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the green accent

blush-wash.$description: Blush Wash — Soft tinted surface for cards and badges tied to the pink accent

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Soft tinted surface tied to the blue accent — appears in gradient fills and decorative washes

noto-serif.$description: All editorial headlines and section titles — the serif against a sans UI gives the brand an editorial, almost magazine-like voice. Used at 77px for hero display, scaling down through 63/49/42/35/26px for h1→h5.

manrope.$description: Body copy, UI controls, navigation, button labels, badges, and large numeric display. 18–19px for body, 14–16px for compact UI, 11px with +0.06em tracking for eyebrow labels like 'TRUSTED BY' and section kickers. The geometric construction balances the serif headlines.
